notes.title: Discover Anima, the latest free game from Campus ADN!
Stiil working on it
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

The graduates are super excited to present their work in such a fantastic community. 

There are still working on bugs and various issues with the game so please be noted that there will be a new release in a few days that hopellly will fix most of the issues one can experience while playing our title.

Please feel free to send us your comments so the team can work on the best next release possible.

Thank you all for your help and patience!
